text:
Type: low two-door storage cabinet
Use: storing media, games, dishes and books behind doors; living room, dining room, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board body, doors with a fine wavy embossed texture, small plastic feet
Colors: white
Shape: long low rectangular box with two flush handleless doors, subtle horizontal wave texture, crisp square edges, tiny feet, clean and compact, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, calm, clean, textured
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, natural textiles; Scandinavian, minimalist or coastal living rooms

product.name: BEST
product.description: May be completed with knobs or handles. Sold separately. Drill template for marking of hole positions for handles or knobs is sold separately. View more product information A simple unit can be enough storage for a limited space or the foundation for a larger storage solution if your needs change.
